name: TC-367: 'Today's Deals' on /menu offers the owner's deal; toggling it OFF in Manage Deals removes it, ON brings it back
description: Storefront /menu renders the DealCard for the API-seeded combo (name, 'Save 21%', 'Includes:' one '1x' chip per slot row, struck $26.50 / $21.00, 'View Deal' → /deals/<id>). The owner flips the row's switch OFF in ?tab=deals → the storefront no longer offers it (public /active hides INACTIVE); ON → back.
